description: The reference library (unsigned) plus a second top-level folder "extra/" holding one file, as when two folders are compressed together.

app.note: APP-02 recognises this format by manifest.json in the single top-level folder, which this ZIP does not have; an app that recognises the format before applying section 6 answers M-20 (not a song library) instead of M-05. Either way the import is refused.

editor.note: The Editor takes the folder that holds manifest.json as the library folder; the rest of the library is the valid reference.
